question:
A hydrogen atom in level $n=4$ emits a photon and comes to $n=2$.

(a) Find the photon energy $E_{42}$ (in eV).

(b) Assume a free nucleus of mass $M\approx 200u$ initially at rest emits a $\gamma$-ray of the same energy $E_{42}$. Estimate the recoil kinetic energy using

$$K_R\approx \frac{E^2}{2Mc^2},$$

and the recoil speed using $p=\dfrac{E}{c}$ and $v=\dfrac{p}{M}$.

Take $1u=1.6605\times10^{-27}\,\text{kg}$, $1u\,c^2=931.5\,\text{MeV}$, $1\,\text{eV}=1.602\times10^{-19}\,\text{J}$
